speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis

The clinical picture of fever, flank pain, fatigue, and recent antibiotic use (Amoxicillin/Cephalexin) for sinusitis strongly suggests a kidney infection. The rash you developed on Amoxicillin is a known hypersensitivity that is distinct from the current urinary system infection. I have already ordered a Urinalysis and Urine Culture to confirm the diagnosis; these results will likely show signs of a bacterial infection in your urine. Based on the classic presentation of flank pain and fever following a recent infection, the diagnosis is Pyelonephritis.
